name: codex-context-bar
description: Context bar for Codex: context window fill, tokens in/out per turn, cached tokens, and estimated cost, read from the session rollout.

interface.shortDescription: See the context window, tokens in/out and cost
interface.longDescription: Reports the session's context window fill, tokens in/out per turn, cached tokens and estimated cost. Ships a one-line bar, a per-turn ledger, and an inline card rendered in the conversation. Reads the session's own rollout under ~/.codex/sessions, so it costs nothing but the read.
defaultPrompt: Show the context bar for this session
Show my context usage as a card
Break down this session's tokens and cost per turn
